title: A Trip to Grandma's House
text: Every summer, I visit my grandma. I live far away, so I miss her a lot. This year, my mom said, "Let's go see grandma this weekend!" I know it will be fun, and I like to wear my favorite yellow shirt when we travel. On Saturday, I wake up early and get ready. We take the bus, and I look out the window the whole way. When we arrive, grandma opens the door and gives me a big hug. "Welcome home!" she says. I can smell her delicious soup from the kitchen. We sit down at the table, and I try a new dish. "I want more, please," I say, and everyone starts to laugh. After lunch, grandma shows me her garden. She tells me the names of all her flowers, and I touch the soft petals gently. Then we walk around the pond and watch the ducks swim. My cousin comes to meet us too, and we play a game. He wants to win, but I win instead! Grandma says, "Don't worry, we can play again." Before we leave, I thank grandma for everything and put my shoes on. I need to wait a whole year to visit again, but I can't wait!
